correctness.rationale: Outer Steiner mass-moment expansion q(t)=A+Lt+pi*t^2 and M(t)=AG+LtH+pi*t^2 S follows by adding outward polygon edge strips and exterior circular sectors, with cubic normal moments cancelling, then convex approximation. Barycentric weights lead to lambda_H^2=(L^2/A*pi)*lambda_G*lambda_S and a strictly hyperbolic conic when centers are noncollinear (strict isoperimetric inequality). Differentiating confirms determinant 2AL*pi*det(H-G,S-G)/q(t)^3 and noninflection. For triangles, physical center determinant is A/(6L*pi)*det(1,a_i,alpha_i). The sine law and strict sine concavity give scalene iff curved, with Hermite-Genocchi second-divided-difference lower bound by min sin(alpha)/2. Direct apex-coordinate ordering gives monotone straight paths for nonequilateral isosceles triangles. Eighty independently sampled triangle configurations and curvature identities were checked; universality follows from the analytic derivation.
